summary: Phase 2 Creator Greylist Tracking Module — full backend + frontend verification. All 25 unit tests pass (18 creator_greylist + 7 _exit_param). All 4 API endpoints work correctly. Frontend Creator Greylist panel mounts on dashboard, renders 3 seeded creators with correct tier scoring, row expansion shows detail breakdown, min-score filter works, sweep button fires API + shows toast, mode toggle (TELEMETRY↔LIVE) triggers native confirm() dialog and persists to backend. After testing, backend creator_greylist_mode confirmed restored to 'telemetry'.

minor.issue: Response JSON key is 'creators_touched' instead of 'creators_refreshed' specified in review request. Functional but spec/contract drift — frontend currently treats it correctly via the toast generator, but external consumers expecting 'creators_refreshed' would break.

issues: Confirmation uses native window.confirm() which (a) cannot be styled to match the rest of the dark dashboard, (b) is auto-dismissed by some headless automation tools, (c) shows browser-chrome 'OK/Cancel' rather than a dedicated 'Enable LIVE / Cancel' pair. Consider replacing with the existing shadcn AlertDialog used elsewhere in the app for consistency.

action_items: Optional: rename failure-sweep response key 'creators_touched' → 'creators_refreshed' to match the documented contract (or update docs to say creators_touched). Frontend already handles both via the toast string.
Optional UX: replace window.confirm() in CreatorGreylistPanel.toggleMode with the shadcn AlertDialog used elsewhere so the dark theme is preserved and the confirm button can read 'Enable LIVE'.
critical_code_review_comments: creator_greylist.strategy_overrides() correctly returns a fresh dict copy each call (test_strategy_overrides_returns_copy_not_shared_dict passes) — prevents module-level template poisoning under concurrent entries.

BotState._exit_param correctly isolates overrides per slot — test_exit_param_independent_per_slot proves three open positions on different tiers each get their own TP/SL with no cross-talk. This is the core safety invariant for Phase 2 live mode.
_exit_param handles None slot, empty overrides, missing key, and None-valued overrides — all four malformed-input paths covered. Good defensive coding.

Trade model carries greylist_strategy_at_entry / greylist_score_at_entry / greylist_overrides_at_entry — confirmed via Pydantic field reflection. These are the audit fields needed to post-hoc evaluate whether the live overrides outperformed the standard config; recommend adding a small analytics endpoint (Phase 2.5) that groups closed trades by greylist_strategy_at_entry and reports mean PnL%.

CreatorGreylistPanel uses a single API call /api/creator-greylist on mount + after sweep + after mode toggle — no polling loop. Acceptable for now; if user keeps the panel open during a long session, stale scores will silently age. Consider auto-refresh every 60s OR a subtle 'last loaded N min ago' label.

Live-mode warning chip ('⚠ LIVE: overrides active on entry') is rendered only when mode=='live' AND items.length>0. If items=0 the user could be in live mode without any on-screen indicator beyond the small button text. Minor.
Greylist endpoint returns mongo docs but the API layer correctly excludes _id (verified in API JSON output — no _id leak). Good.
